scores.notes: Compared the leaping Peter (left) with the foreground disciple carrying the net and staff (right), the only figure matching him: both have curly salt-and-pepper hair, a grey beard, a weathered middle-aged face and a brown shaggy coat.

Left Daniel (pulled on the rope at left) has long, wavy, shoulder-length grey hair swept back and a short trimmed beard. Right Daniel (centre of the den) has short-cropped grey hair and a fuller white beard, so the hair length and style conflict.

Both show a dirt track with dry-stone walls and a wooden gate, olive trees, terraced hills, stone farmhouses and a lake in the distance, all in warm daylight; they read as one place from different angles.
Both show a wooden mast boat on dark, rough water at night under a full moon, with a stone village on the left-hand shore.

Left shows the seabed between towering water walls under a bright daytime sky with low hills ahead. Right is dark and night-like, with a beam of light, red cliffs and a walled city on a headland, and the sea only beginning to part; the lighting and the coastline conflict.
Both are dim, stormy scenes with a glowing pillar in the sky over a sea parting into a sandy path, with a walled city on the right-hand horizon; the cliffs and dunes on the far shore are compatible.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore with a charcoal fire, a fishing boat at the water's edge, and a stone village with palms and cypresses on the right-hand hillside under soft morning light.
Both show a winding dusty road between dry-stone walls, olive trees and terraced hills under daylight; the stone house on the left and the rocky slopes on the right are compatible.

Both show a dry seabed at night between tall walls of dark green water under stormy or moonlit cloud, so they are compatible. The right adds a city on the clifftop, which the left's taller walls would hide.

Left Jesus (by the fire, mostly turned away, with a smaller Jesus-like figure among the disciples) and right Jesus (standing in the stern) all share long wavy dark-brown hair, a full brown beard and the same apparent age.
Both show a wooden sailing boat on rough grey-green waves under dark storm clouds, with light at the horizon and a rocky headland on the right.
Both show a wooden fishing boat on a dark, choppy sea under storm clouds, with a light horizon and hilly headlands, so they are compatible. The right sky is clearing as the storm calms.
Compared the leaping Peter (left) with the foreground disciple holding the net and staff (right): both have curly dark hair going grey, a grey-streaked beard, tanned skin and a middle-aged face.
Both show the wooden boat with a furled sail on dark, rough water under heavy storm clouds, with a bright band at the horizon and a rocky headland on the right.
Both show a pebbly lakeshore with a fire, moored boats, and a stone village on the right-hand shore below hills, lit by the low morning sun.

Left shows a shallow, open, brick-lined pit whose rim reaches Daniel's chest, in rocky ground with palms and city walls. Right shows a deep cylindrical shaft of large blocks whose walls rise several times a man's height, so the architecture conflicts.
Both show a wooden sailing boat in a rainy storm at night under a full moon, with high waves, a dark shoreline and other boats nearby.
Both show a night storm under a moon behind clouds, with a wooden mast boat on rough water and a hilly or village shore in the distance.
Moses at the front of the column (left) and Moses on the shore with his arm out (right) are both elderly, with shoulder-length white hair, a full white beard and a similar weathered face.
Both show a circular pit walled with stone blocks, a sandy or straw floor, resting lions, and barred openings near the top, lit at dawn; the details are compatible from different viewpoints.

Left has a dark blue storm sky, moderate water walls and a horizon of dunes with a walled city. Right has a bright, warm daylight sky, far taller water walls and open blue hills beyond, so the lighting and the far shore conflict.
Both are night scenes under a moon, with a sandy path through green-crested water and a walled city on the coastal heights to the right.
Both are night scenes under dark clouds and moonlight, with the sea parted around a dry path. The left is wider, showing cliffs and a city; the right is a close view between tall walls.
Moses leading the column (left, front view) and Moses on the shore (right, in profile) are both elderly, with long white hair and a full white beard.

Left Daniel at the rim has long wavy grey-white hair and a full grey beard and looks elderly. Right Daniel in the den has short-cropped grey hair and only a short stubble beard and looks younger, so the hair, beard and age conflict.
